identity.name: Kailali Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: One of the largest community campuses in the Sudurpashchim Province of Nepal, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Kailali Multiple Campus (KMC), established in 1979, is a prominent community-owned higher education institution located in Dhangadhi, Kailali. It offers diverse academic programs under Tribhuvan University, ranging from humanities and management to science and education streams.

recognition_details: Approved by Tribhuvan University and UGC Nepal

academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practical sessions, assignments, and interactive discussions.

programs.eligibility: +2 or equivalent in any stream with minimum second division.

programs.entrance_requirement: Entrance exam conducted by TU IOST
